title: FarcasterFrameEvent
description: An interaction event from a BibleFi Farcaster Frame. BibleFi is deployed as a native Base App and Farcaster mini-app. Frame events capture user interactions with scripture views, tithing flows, DeFi strategy entries, and church discovery within Farcaster casts.

fid.description: Farcaster ID (FID) of the interacting user

verified_address.description: Primary verified Ethereum address linked to Farcaster account

frame_action.description: Action taken within the BibleFi Farcaster Frame

frame_uri.description: URI of the BibleFi Farcaster Frame that triggered this event

cast_hash.description: Hash of the Farcaster cast containing this frame

channel_id.description: Farcaster channel where the frame was cast. BibleFi channels: /biblefi, /faith, /christianity, /defi

input_text.description: Text input from the frame if applicable

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID for frame actions that initiate on-chain transactions

connected_wallet.description: Wallet connected via Farcaster frame authentication (Base chain)

chain_id.description: Chain ID for transaction-type frame actions. Base mainnet = 8453

biblefi_action.description: BibleFi-specific action metadata linking this frame event to BibleFi protocol objects

amount_wei.description: Transaction amount in wei for mint/tithe/stake actions

estimated_gas_wei.description: Estimated gas cost in wei on Base chain
